verdict.rationale: Veriff explicitly advertises a 'No-code identity verification solution' (veriff-docs-4) and a Customer Portal for manual review/session management (veriff-docs-12, veriff-docs-13, veriff-docs-26, veriff-docs-46, veriff-docs-47), plus a no-code Zapier integration for automating decisions (veriff-docs-43), suggesting non-engineering usage is possible. However, none of the evidence explicitly documents an ops lead generating a shareable verification link or QR code from the portal for a one-off individual without API/SDK integration — most flows described (sessions API, SDKs, webhooks) require engineering setup. Missing for 10: explicit portal feature/screenshot showing 'create verification link/QR code' workflow, confirmation that no API key or dev work is needed to send a one-off link.
